selection_contract.correct_controls: One correct test prediction per leaf, selected deterministically nearest to that leaf's median correct confidence; relative-path lexical order breaks ties.
selection_contract.cross_parent_errors: All two cross-parent errors from the frozen test predictions.
selection_contract.high_confidence_errors: All seven leaf errors with confidence >= 0.99.
selection_contract.dominant_oral_confusion: One error nearest the direction-specific median confidence for oral_normal->oral_scc and one for oral_scc->oral_normal.

interpretation_limitations: Grad-CAM is a coarse localization of model influence, not object detection.
A highlighted region is not proof of medical correctness or causality.
This audit uses the held-out test set post hoc and does not change model selection or performance metrics.
The result is specific to this dataset, checkpoint and preprocessing contract.
